info.title: Internet Quality API
info.description:
API educacional de previsão de qualidade de conexão.

Camada de desacoplamento:

`RIPE Atlas → dados históricos → Model A/B/C/D → predictions.csv → esta API → aplicativos mobile`

Esta API **não** consulta o RIPE Atlas e **não** executa nenhum modelo.
Ela lê o catálogo em `data/models.json` e previsões já calculadas em CSV.
O aplicativo escolhe um modelo via `GET /api/v1/models` e envia `model_id` nas consultas.

Classificação de campos no schema:

- **SOURCE** — valor com correspondência a um campo RIPE Atlas (probe ou medição de ping)
- **DERIVED** — calculado a partir de campos RIPE (ex.: packet loss a partir de `sent` e `rcvd`)
- **PREDICTED** — produzido pelo modelo/pipeline, não pelo RIPE Atlas
- **BUSINESS** — regra de negócio desta API (qualidade, score, recomendação)

As categorias GOOD / MODERATE / UNSTABLE são regras experimentais do protótipo.
Não são classificações do RIPE Atlas.

contact.name: Internet Quality API — disciplina de Dispositivos Móveis

get.description: Confirms that the API process is running. Does not query RIPE Atlas.

Returns catalog entries with `active=true`, ordered by name. The mobile app should call this first, let the user pick a model, and send that `id` as `model_id` on forecast endpoints. No model is treated as default or scientifically superior. `algorithm` is metadata only; this API never executes a model.
Returns one catalog entry, including inactive models.

get.description: Returns probes that currently have prediction data. Coordinates come from RIPE Atlas probe geometry semantics (GeoJSON `[longitude, latitude]`), exposed here as named fields. Public probe coordinates are privacy-protected and must not be treated as the exact user location. Probe IP addresses are never returned.

get.summary: Nearest forecast for a probe and model
get.description: Returns the nearest upcoming prediction for the given probe **and** `model_id`. Predictions from other models are never mixed. If every stored prediction is in the past, the latest available row is returned. `quality` and `recommendation` come from the shared backend classifiers, not from the selected algorithm.

get.summary: Forecast timeline for a probe and model
get.description: Returns predictions for one probe and one `model_id`, ordered by `predictionFor`. Optional `from` and `to` are inclusive UTC instants. `limit` is capped.

schema.description: Unique identifier of the prediction model selected by the user.

404.description: Unknown/inactive model or no prediction data for this probe.

get.summary: Compare active models for a probe
get.description: Returns the same instant across all active models that have data for this probe. If `prediction_for` is omitted, the nearest upcoming common instant is used. This endpoint does **not** rank models or declare a winner. Quality labels use the same QualityClassifier for every model.

parameters.name: prediction_for

schema.description: UTC instant to compare. Must exist for every active model included.
schema.title: Prediction For

parameters.description: UTC instant to compare. Must exist for every active model included.

404.description: Probe without data or no shared prediction instant.

get.summary: Forecast for the nearest available probe of a model
get.description: Validates `model_id`, selects the geographically nearest probe that has predictions for that model (Haversine), and returns its nearest upcoming forecast. This is a geographic reference to a RIPE Atlas probe, not a measurement of the user device.

404.description: Unknown/inactive model or no probe inside the optional radius.

422.description: Invalid latitude, longitude, or missing model_id.

post.summary: Check whether an activity looks suitable
post.description: Combines the nearest probe forecast at the requested instant with an experimental activity rule for the selected `modelId`. Suitability is a BUSINESS decision of this prototype. The same QualityClassifier and RecommendationService are used for every model. The matched probe is only a geographic reference.

predictedPacketLossPct.title: Predictedpacketlosspct
predictedPacketLossPct.description: PREDICTED — Forecast of future packet loss in percent. Historical value is DERIVED from RIPE Atlas ping `sent` and `rcvd` as ((sent - rcvd) / sent) * 100 when sent > 0. There is no original RIPE field named packet_loss.

modelConfidence.title: Modelconfidence
modelConfidence.description: PREDICTED — Optional model-produced confidence in [0, 1]. Not a RIPE Atlas field. May be null when the model does not provide confidence.
